### Headline summary
- JPMorgan, Visa, and Mastercard confirmed data breaches following a cyberattack on a third-party service provider. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/jpmorgan-visa-mastercard-cite-third-party-incidents-amid-data-leak/), [HackRead](https://hackread.com/jpmorgan-chase-visa-mastercard-vendor-incidents-n0n-leak/))
- China-linked hackers are actively exploiting a critical VMware vCenter zero-day to hijack admin accounts and steal data. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/vmware-patches-vcenter-zero-day-exploited-in-attacks-since-september/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/hackers-exploit-vmware-vcenter-0-day/))
- Threat actors are using a critical Cisco Expressway flaw to gain root access and move laterally within internal networks. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/hackers-exploit-critical-cisco.html), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203598/hacking/hackers-exploit-cisco-expressway-flaw-cve-2026-76466-to-breach-russian-organization.html))

### JPMorgan, Visa, and Mastercard Confirm Third-Party Data Breaches
JPMorgan Chase, Visa, and Mastercard confirmed data breaches affecting customer information following a cyberattack on a third-party service provider. The N0n extortion group claimed responsibility for the incident, leaking data linked to the financial institutions. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/jpmorgan-visa-mastercard-cite-third-party-incidents-amid-data-leak/), [HackRead](https://hackread.com/jpmorgan-chase-visa-mastercard-vendor-incidents-n0n-leak/), [Malwarebytes Labs (Vendor)](https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/data-breaches/2026/11/hackers-leak-data-linked-to-visa-mastercard-and-jpmorgan-customers), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203614/data-breach/jpmorgan-visa-and-mastercard-report-third-party-data-breaches-after-n0n-claims.html))

### VMware vCenter Zero-Day Exploited by China-Linked Hackers
A suspected China-linked espionage group exploited a critical VMware vCenter Server zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-123890) to hijack admin accounts and steal data. Broadcom released emergency security updates to patch the authentication bypass flaw that was exploited since September. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/vmware-patches-vcenter-zero-day-exploited-in-attacks-since-september/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/hackers-exploit-vmware-vcenter-0-day/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/china-linked-hackers-exploit-critical.html), [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/20/vmware-vcenter-zero-day-cve-2026-123890-exploited/))

### Hackers Exploit Cisco Expressway Flaw for Root Access
Threat actors are actively exploiting a critical security flaw in Cisco Expressway (CVE-2026-76466) to gain root access and move laterally within internal networks. The vulnerability has been used to breach devices and compromise organizations. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/hackers-exploit-critical-cisco.html), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203598/hacking/hackers-exploit-cisco-expressway-flaw-cve-2026-76466-to-breach-russian-organization.html))

### Windows 11 FastUnlock Zero-Day Bypasses BitLocker
A newly disclosed unpatched zero-day technique called FastUnlock allows attackers with physical access to a locked Windows 11 PC to bypass BitLocker protections. The flaw enables the execution of programs on the device without authentication. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/windows-11-narrator-lock-screen-0-day/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/new-unpatched-windows-0-day-fastunlock.html))

### NGINX2Root vulnerability exposure
8.8 million NGINX services remain potentially exposed to the critical NGINX2Root vulnerability, a set of five new flaws for which Cloudflare has implemented protections for its origins. ([Cloudflare](https://blog.cloudflare.com/nginx2root/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/nginx2root-vulnerability/))

### Critical Apache Tomcat Flaw Lets Remote Attackers Join Trusted Server Clusters Without Authentication
The Apache Software Foundation has disclosed a critical flaw in Apache Tomcat that allows a remote attacker to join a trusted server cluster without authentication. Tracked as CVE-2026-133325, the flaw affects clusters that use TLS 1.3 with a pre-shared key. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/critical-apache-tomcat-flaw/))

### CVE-2026-126714: phpAfterShell PHP Session Flaw Can Lead to Remote Code Execution
The PHP development team has released security updates addressing CVE-2026-126714, a critical vulnerability dubbed phpAfterShell that can turn partially overwritten session files into an arbitrary deserialization primitive and potentially remote code execution. The flaw carries a CVSS v4.0 score of… ([SOC Prime Blog](https://socprime.com/blog/cve-2026-126714-phpaftershell-php-session-flaw-can-lead-to-remote-code-execution/))

### Ruby2Shell Heap Overflow Vulnerability Patched
Ruby maintainers released security updates to address CVE-2026-132825, a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability. The flaw, known as Ruby2Shell, could potentially lead to remote code execution. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/ruby-patches-ruby2shell-vulnerability-that-could-lead-to-rce/), [SOC Prime Blog](https://socprime.com/blog/cve-2026-132825-ruby2shell-heap-overflow-can-lead-to-remote-code-execution/))
